SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2896.
Section 2. Station:
T. P. H. Q.
Date November 17, 1931.）

Subject (in full) Mr. and Mrs. J. Greiner.

Made by D.S. Moore. Forwarded by （签名）

The male bearing the above name is a Shanghai born
German-Chinese Eurasian, his father being German and his mother
Chinese and he works as an accountant for The China Soap Co.
Ltd, 18 The Bund. He is registered as a German subject at the
local consulate of that nationality although his knowledge of
the German language is very slight.
On July 10, 1931 he married at the local German
Consulate an Australian-Japanese Eurasian girl, the daughter of
Mr. Vivian Smith, Secretary of the Chinese Government Directorate
General of Posts, Development Department. Following the marriage,
the couple lived with friends until the beginning of September
then removed to Flat 319 of 368 Kiangse Road. Here they stayed
for about a month, but are now residing in a boarding house kept
by a German lady, Mrs. F. Lacher at 70-72 Route de Grouchy,
French Concession.
Johan Greiner is about 25/26 years of age, about
5' 5" in height has thick dark hair parted at the left side,
has deep set dark eyes, sallow complexion and broad face.
He neither smokes nor drinks and is regarded as a very steady
living man whose chief interest lies in the study of books likely
to improve his already fairly extensive knowledge of accountancy
and he is not known to have or to have expressed at any time
views on any particular political ideal.

（签名）
Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：Side Mks
17/11/31）

表格第3号
G. 21,503-1-31

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处
编号 S. B. D. 2896.
第二科。警署：
总巡捕房总部。
日期 1931年11月17日。）

主题（全称） J. Greiner 先生及夫人。

制作人 D.S. Moore。转呈人 （签名）

上述姓名的男子为生于上海的德中混血欧亚人，其父为德国人，其母为中国人，他在外滩18号的中国肥皂有限公司（The China Soap Co. Ltd）担任会计。尽管他的德语知识非常浅薄，但他仍在该国驻本地领事馆注册为德国籍民。
1931年7月10日，他在当地德国领事馆娶了一位澳日混血欧亚女子为妻，该女子是国民政府交通部邮政总局秘书 Vivian Smith 先生的女儿。婚后，这对夫妇与朋友同住，直至九月初，随后搬至江西路368号319室公寓。他们在此居住了约一个月，但目前居住在法租界古鲁西路（Route de Grouchy）70-72号由一位德国女士 F. Lacher 夫人经营的寄宿公寓内。
Johan Greiner 年龄约25至26岁，身高约5英尺5英寸，黑发浓密，左侧分缝，眼窝深陷，瞳色深，面色萎黄，脸型宽阔。
他不吸烟也不饮酒，被视为生活非常稳重的人，其主要兴趣在于研读那些可能提升其已相当广博的会计知识的书籍，且据知他从未持有或表达过任何特定政治理想方面的观点。

（签名）
特别股主管警官。

（批注：侧边标记
1931年11月17日）
